lexicalDispositions.disposition: Reuse exact existing haiku and actor words, preserving their N2 and N3 vocabulary levels respectively, all metadata and teaching. Only component links change. The two words demonstrate different semantic families, not a requirement that every actor compose poetry or every haiku be humorous.

Haiku pictures, poets, literary circles, prose/flavor, pen names, literary style and gatherings or games. Recognition evidence, not sixteen necessary support additions. Preserve both 俳名 readings and do not confuse homophonous 俳友 with 俳優; no new frequency rankings or histories inferred.

Haikai and historical humorous linked verse; 俳諧 also has a poetical comical/absurd sense. Preserve historical/poetical flags and the rare-kanji label on 誹諧. These explain why not every haiku must be a joke; no exhaustive literary history is added.
俳徊 and 徘回 are search-only spellings within 徘徊/はいかい. Do not put 俳徊 into Common words or advertise it as normal wandering vocabulary. A search-only spelling is not an ordinary reading example.
Stage, film, character, tragic and action actors. Full families corroborate acting scope; tragedy-related 悲劇俳優 does not make 俳 itself mean sadness. No additional support articles needed.

comparisonDispositions.disposition: Acting, poet, leading role/performer, female actor and actor with figurative cunning-person sense. Preserve person/activity distinctions and existing quiz guards. Separate 川柳 verse, tree/tea and archaic tree families; the existing article has primary せんりゅう and explicit reading distinctions and a direct 俳句 exclusion. A shared spelling does not merge these lexical identities.

非 fault/negation and 悲 Buddhist compassion senses supplement actual current character articles and raw KANJIDIC2. Neither establishes haiku or actor as a character meaning. No mechanical negation of the new compounds is taught.

Gentle prefix, grade/excellence and adjectival 優 families. Raw KANJIDIC2 separately recognizes actor for 優; absence from these standalone families is not proof that its performer role in 俳優 is invalid. Do not select 優 as a wrong actor option merely because its displayed title is gentle; superior.
